note: The taxonomy ledger (D421). A lane that meets a question fitting no existing category PARKS it here instead of dropping it, and scripts/topic-budget.mjs decides from this file whether the gap has become a topic. Written by lanes through their own PR; read by npm run topic:budget; held honest by check:taxonomy. Empty is the correct state when no lane has met an unfittable question — proposals accumulate, they are not seeded.
